name: menu
title: The main menu
caption: Continue where you stopped, your audiobooks, your music, speakers, settings, help.

name: menu-more
title: The rest of the menu
caption: Scroll down for Listen on, Settings, Status and Help.

name: now-playing
title: Now playing
caption: The cover, the title, who is singing, and where it is playing. Turn the wheel for volume.

name: in-progress
title: In progress
caption: Books you have started, with how far through each one you are.

name: book-now-playing
title: An audiobook
caption: An audiobook shows its chapter. Press play, and it carries on from where you stopped.

name: books
title: One author's books
caption: Each book shows its length and whether it is saved on the iPod to play offline.

name: bedtime-lock
title: Bedtime
caption: When tonight's listening is used up, it says goodnight. Only a grown-up's code (or Wi-Fi settings) works.

name: ha-device-top
title: The player in Home Assistant
caption: Its own device page: battery, whether bedtime is locked, minutes left, what it is playing and where, and a Find it button.

name: ha-device-config
title: Every setting, in Home Assistant
caption: Bedtime window and allowance, click sound, names, Find My, hold time, the 'if found' contact and more. Change one and the player has it within a minute.

name: ha-device-config-more
title: More settings
caption: Speakers counted elsewhere, unlock speed, voice on the iPod only, volume limit, wheel click and direction.
